mapper.sql: s.id, s.code, s.name, s.platform, s.marketplace, s.currency, s.timezone, s.customer_id, s.warehouse_id, s.platform_warehouse_id, s.commission_rate, s.lead_days, s.safety_days, s.owner_id, s.seller_id, s.last_sync_time, s.status, s.remark, s.create_time, s.update_time, CASE WHEN s.credentials IS NOT NULL AND s.credentials <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_credentials, c.name AS customer_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, pw.name AS platform_warehouse_name, u.nickname AS owner_name, COALESCE(l.listing_count, 0) AS listing_count

FROM ecom_store s LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse pw ON pw.id = s.platform_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.owner_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM ecom_listing WHERE status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY store_id) l ON l.store_id = s.id
